about_the_game:
Game Overview:

Friendly Duel is a fun-filled soccer competitive game designed to allow players to have a relaxed duel with friends or other players. The goal of the game is to score as many goals as possible within the specified time while enjoying a relaxed atmosphere.

Gameplay:

In Friendly Duel, players can choose between single-player and multiplayer modes. In single-player mode, you can challenge AI opponents to hone your skills, while in multiplayer mode, you can compete with friends in real time. Each game lasts five minutes, and players strive to score as many goals as possible within this time.

Control:

The control scheme is simple and intuitive. Players can use the arrow keys to move the character and the space bar to shoot. The design is flexible and user-friendly, suitable for players of all ages. Whether you are a soccer novice or an experienced player, you can easily get involved.

Game Features:

Customizable Characters: Players can personalize their characters, including appearance and skills, to create a unique soccer star.

Diverse Venue Selection: The game offers multiple arenas, each with its own unique style and challenges.

Visuals and Sound Effects:

The game uses cartoon graphics style with bright colors and smooth animations. The cheerful soundtrack enhances the game atmosphere and provides players with a pleasant experience while playing.

Conclusion:

Friendly Duel is an easy-to-play yet challenging football competitive game. Whether you want to relax or test your skills, this game has something for everyone. Gather your friends, step into the world of football, and experience the excitement of the game!
